hints.title: Iterate Starting Positions
hints.text: Consider every pair of start indices (i, j) in string s and string t.

hints.title: Count Character Mismatches
hints.text: Extend substrings simultaneously from i and j, tallying the number of differing characters.

hints.title: Stop After Second Difference
hints.text: When differences equal one, increment the total count. When differences exceed one, break the inner loop.

hints.title: Full Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Generating all substrings into a hash table takes substantial string hashing and memory.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Dual pointer extension uses O(1) space and executes within 10^6 basic operations.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should notice m, n <= 100 and formulate clean early-stopping extension.
